_about: Reward rules read from the issuers' own terms (HDFC Millennia T&C 20 Jul 2026, Swiggy HDFC T&C 18 Sep 2026, HDFC UPI RuPay T&C 27 Mar 2025, HDFC MITC v4.17 Oct 2026, SBI Cashback T&C kit, HSBC Live+ service guide + key fact statement). Shapes follow rewardTypes.d.ts (CardRewardRules). Rates are { value, per } in rupees, so 1 CashPoint = Rs 0.25 is already converted. Nothing here is personal data. Cards added 31 Oct 2026 from each issuer's own card page, T&C or MITC (source and date saved on every card); cards whose rates could not be confirmed from an official source were left out. Details the app cannot model (tiers, shared caps, per-quarter caps, day-of-week rates, online vs offline) are in each card's notes. Categories use the app's simple list (see CATEGORY_LIST in src/lib/options.js); spend types with no matching category are kept as plain text in exclusions.otherSpendTypes.

No effective date stated; effectiveFrom is the date read. Not modelled: annual-spend slabs, incremental per slab: up to Rs 1,00,000 = 1 pt/Rs100, 1,00,001-2,50,000 = 2x, 2,50,001-5,00,000 = 4x, above 5,00,000 = 6x. Accelerated slabs not earned on utility, insurance, government, education, real estate, rent. Cash redemption max 5,000 pts per calendar month from 1 Sep 2024. 1 pt = Rs 0.40 cash credit.

cards.name: IndusInd Bank Legend Credit Card
cards.source: IndusInd Bank Legend Credit Card product page https://www.indusind.bank.in/in/en/personal/cards/credit-card/legend-credit-card.html . No effective date stated for the current rule; effectiveFrom is the date read. Not modelled: weekend (Sat/Sun) spend earns 2 pts per Rs 100 instead of 1; medical, automobile and telecom earn 1 pt per Rs 100 on weekdays and weekends (from 1 Jan 2022); fuel earns nothing (from 1 Apr 2018); 3,000 bonus points on Rs 5,00,000+ spend within a year of issue. Page does not state a rupee value per point.

cards.name: RBL Bank ShopRite Credit Card
cards.source: RBL Bank ShopRite Credit Card product page https://www.rbl.bank.in/personal-banking/cards/credit-cards/shoprite-credit-card ; product T&C https://webassets.rbl.bank.in/document/credit-cards/tnc-shoprite-credit-card.pdf ; MITC https://webassets.rbl.bank.in/document/Credit%20Cards/RBL-MITC-final.pdf . Page read 2026-10-31; 15 Oct 2024 is the date the page states for added exclusions. Page: each reward point redeemable for up to Rs 0.25. Railways treatment is unclear on the page so it is not listed as an exclusion.

accelerated.label: 20 points per Rs 100 on grocery
accelerated.notes: Cap is 1,000 reward points per month on grocery spends (page wording). Points credited within 45 days of settlement.

cards.name: RBL Bank Fun+ Credit Card (BookMyShow)
cards.source: RBL Bank Fun+ Credit Card page (no longer accepting applications; replaced by RBL Bank Play card which has no reward points) https://www.rbl.bank.in/personal-banking/cards/credit-cards/fun-plus-credit-card ; product T&C section 3.4 https://webassets.rbl.bank.in/document/credit-cards/terms-conditions-funplus.pdf (file created 2026-05-18, no effective date stated). effectiveFrom is the date read. Not modelled: 20 pts per Rs 100 on dining on weekends (Sat/Sun only, MCC-based). 12,000 bonus points on Rs 4 lakh annual spend. 12,000 points = Rs 3,000 vouchers on the page, so about Rs 0.25 per point.

accelerated.label: 10 points per Rs 100 on BookMyShow, Pizza Hut, KFC
accelerated.notes: T&C: maximum 1,000 accelerated reward points per billing cycle (covers weekend dining and these merchants together). Pizza Hut and KFC identified by dining MCC.

cards.name: Federal Scapia Credit Card
cards.source: Federal Bank Scapia co-branded card page https://www.federal.bank.in/scapia (page last updated 31 Oct 2026; Visa 10% reward on eligible spend, 1 reward = 1 Scapia Coin, 5 coins = Rs 1, no cap stated). MITC v11 (30 Apr 2026) https://www.federal.bank.in/documents/d/guest/mitc-v11-30-4-26-eng could not be read (bot protection), so the list of ineligible spends is NOT confirmed and exclusions are left empty. 10 coins per Rs 100 and Rs 0.20 per coin are derived arithmetic from the page's 10% and 5 coins = Rs 1. RuPay variant earns 5% on spends of Rs 500 or more (not modelled).

cards.name: Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card
cards.source: Smart Credit Card Terms and Conditions https://av.sc.bank.in/content/docs/in-smartcard-product-terms-and-conditions.pdf ; product page https://www.sc.bank.in/credit-cards/smart-credit-card/ . 21 Aug 2024 is the date the T&C moves the cap to client level. Bank rate is 2% on online and 1% on other (offline) spends; online vs offline is by card-network classification and cannot be mapped to app categories, so base is the 1% offline rate and the 2% online rate is NOT modelled. Caps per statement cycle: Rs 1,000 online plus Rs 500 offline (Rs 1,500 combined used as capPerCycle). No cashback on fuel, returns, finance charges, cash advances; bill payments through Billdesk/StanChart Bill Pay earn only for telecom and utilities billers.

cards.name: Standard Chartered Ultimate Credit Card
cards.source: Standard Chartered Ultimate Credit Card Terms and Conditions, Section 3 https://www.sc.bank.in/content/dam/sc/in/credit-cards/docs/in-ultimate-credit-card-tnc.pdf (5 pts per Rs 150, reduced from 2 Apr 2023 to 3 pts per Rs 150 on utilities, supermarkets, insurance, property management, schools, government payments; no points on fuel, ATM, returns, finance charges). Point value not stated in the T&C text read, so pointValue is null. Property management is not mapped to a category.

accelerated.label: Reduced 3 points per Rs 150 on utilities, supermarkets, insurance, schools, government
accelerated.notes: This is a LOWER rate than base, applied to the categories the bank lists (utilities, supermarkets, insurance, property management, schools and government payments). Effective 2 Apr 2023.

cards.name: HSBC Premier Credit Card
cards.source: HSBC Rewards Marketplace Terms and Conditions (Premier section) https://www.hsbc.bank.in/content/dam/hsbc/in/documents/hsbc-rewards-tcs.pdf ; rewards page https://www.hsbc.bank.in/credit-cards/products/premier/rewards/ . Document is copyright 2025 with no effective date; effectiveFrom is the date read. 3 pts per Rs 100, no points on fuel (MCC 5541, 5983, 5172, 5542, 5552), cash advances, fees, disputed; no points on Instant EMI. Not modelled: spend in utilities, tax, real estate, non-financial institutions, money transfer, jewelry, insurance, financial institutions, e-wallets, bail and bond, education and government earns points only up to Rs 1,00,000 cumulative per month. Travel with Points portal bookings earn 18 pts/Rs100 flights, 36 hotels, 6 car rental, accelerated cap 18,000 pts per calendar month. Points do not expire. Point value not stated generally (1 pt = Rs 1 on Apple only).

cards.name: OneCard (Federal Bank One Co-Branded Credit Card)
cards.source: The Federal Bank One Co-Branded Credit Card MITC, w.e.f. 5 December 2024 https://assets.getonecard.app/assets/legal/MITC_Federal_Bank_1740489777652.pdf (Federal Bank's own page https://www.federal.bank.in/onecard was blocked). 1 reward point per Rs 50, fractional points for smaller amounts. No points on money transfers, rent, fuel (from 15 Dec 2023), cash withdrawals, wallet loads. Not modelled: 5X on the top 2 spend categories each month, only if spend is across at least 3 categories with at least Rs 750 in each (from 6 Jan 2025), credited on the 10th of the next month. Point value not stated in the MITC.

cards.name: American Express Platinum Travel Credit Card
cards.source: American Express Platinum Travel Credit Card page https://www.americanexpress.com/in/credit-cards/platinum-travel-credit-card/ (1 MR point per Rs 50; no points on fuel, insurance, utilities, cash, EMI at POS; EMI exclusion since 15 Mar 2020; milestone bonuses automatic from 9 Mar 2026). 12 Jun 2025 fuel exclusion date comes from Amex India Membership Rewards terms shown in search results, not from this page. Page read 2026-10-31. New applications are paused. Milestone bonus points (Rs 4 lakh = 10,000 pts) not modelled. MR point rupee value not stated.

cards.name: American Express Membership Rewards Credit Card
cards.source: American Express Membership Rewards Credit Card page https://www.americanexpress.com/in/credit-cards/membership-rewards-card/ (1 MR point per Rs 50; no points on fuel, insurance, utilities, cash, EMI at POS; EMI exclusion since 15 Mar 2020). 12 Jun 2025 fuel exclusion date from Amex India MR terms in search results. Page read 2026-10-31. New applications are paused. Not modelled: monthly bonus 1,000 pts for 4 transactions of Rs 1,500+ and 1,000 pts for Rs 20,000+ monthly spend (needs enrollment). MR point rupee value not stated.

cards.name: American Express SmartEarn Credit Card
cards.source: American Express SmartEarn Credit Card page https://www.americanexpress.com/in/credit-cards/smart-earn-credit-card/ ; partner merchant list (as of 28 Aug 2024) https://www.americanexpress.com/content/dam/amex/in/legal/cmu/merchantlist.pdf . Base 1 MR point per Rs 50; no points on fuel, insurance, utilities, cash, EMI at POS. Partner list may change from time to time; the merchant PDF dated 28 Aug 2024 lists 10X: Zomato, EaseMyTrip, Flipkart, Uber, BookMyShow, Ajio, Nykaa, PVR, BlinkIt, Myntra; 5X: Amazon, while the current page text names fewer merchants. 12 Jun 2025 fuel exclusion date from Amex India MR terms in search results. New applications are paused. MR point rupee value not stated.

accelerated.label: 10X (10 points per Rs 50) on Flipkart, Uber, BookMyShow, Ajio, Nykaa, PVR, BlinkIt, Myntra
accelerated.notes: Bank: 10X = 9 extra points per Rs 50 on top of the base 1. 10X points capped at 500 points per month per Card Account jointly for this group. List as of 28 Aug 2024 and may change.

accelerated.label: 10X (10 points per Rs 50) on Zomato and EaseMyTrip
accelerated.notes: Capped at 500 points per month per Card Account for Zomato and EaseMyTrip together. List as of 28 Aug 2024 and may change.

accelerated.label: 5X (5 points per Rs 50) on Amazon
accelerated.notes: Bank: 5X = 4 extra points per Rs 50 on top of the base 1. 5X points capped at 250 points per month per Card Account for Amazon.
